name: uap_visualization
label: UFO / UAP Visualization
description: Evidence-first visualisation of reported observations: plausible night or daylight sky, the reported object shown as an abstract, labelled marker unless the source describes it in detail. Night scenes use a documentary day-for-night exposure so the sky, horizon and object position stay readable.
editorial_rules: Default reconstruction_status is data_visualization; use illustrative_reconstruction only for witness-described shapes and label 'Artist's impression of the reported object'.
Never render a detailed craft that no source describes.
Show source data (sensor overlays, timestamps, flight paths) separated from illustration.
Ordinary explanations (aircraft, balloons, Starlink, Venus, sensor artefacts) get equal visual treatment.
